title: The Healing of the Crippled Woman on the Sabbath
description: Jesus teaches in a synagogue on the Sabbath and heals a woman who has been crippled for eighteen years. The leader of the synagogue is angry because this happens on the Sabbath, but Jesus answers that when one unties an ox or donkey and leads it to water on the Sabbath, then this daughter of Abraham should also be freed from Satan's bonds.
